allow: PowerShell(node --version; npm --version; \(Get-Command pnpm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)?.Source; \(Get-Command firebase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)?.Source)

PowerShell($today = Get-Date; $packages = @\('pnpm', 'firebase-tools'\); foreach \($pkg in $packages\) { $info = npm view $pkg time.created --json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json; $created = [datetime]$info; $days = \($today - $created\).Days; Write-Output "$pkg : published $\($created.ToString\('yyyy-MM-dd'\)\), $days days ago" })

PowerShell($today = Get-Date; $packages = @\('@firebase/util', 'protobufjs'\); foreach \($pkg in $packages\) { $info = npm view $pkg time.created --json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json; $created = [datetime]$info; $days = \($today - $created\).Days; Write-Output "$pkg : $\($created.ToString\('yyyy-MM-dd'\)\) \($days days\)" })
PowerShell(npm view react-hook-form --json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -Property name, @{n='version';e={$_.version}}, @{n='published';e={$_.time.\($_.version\)}})
